reporting_policy: Every user-facing project progress output should report at minimum requirements_structure_percent, g1_system_freeze_percent and backlog_done_percent. Broader engineering percentages must be explicitly labeled estimates.

requirements_structure.meaning: Planned requirement-domain hierarchy/schema/authority coverage, not product-value closure.

g1_system_freeze.note: PB-03 adds source-derived phase-current and measurement-range requirements to the inherited PB-02 mass/thrust/18S/DC baseline. PASS means controlled value closure/traceability, not physical verification.

backlog.note: Conservative metric: only tasks explicitly marked DONE are counted. Sprint S1.1 completion advances UAV-006 but does not complete the full ESC electrical-envelope task because PWM/protection/energy/thermal parents remain open.

gate_closure.note: G0/G1 remain OPEN because flight time/energy/environment, detailed mass allocation, minimum loaded bus/sag, PWM, protection and thermal requirements remain unresolved. G2-G7 remain dependency-blocked.
